purpose: Diagnosis only; not a new production prediction model
evidence_observed_before_registration: All V20r2 modes have negative five-day and technology IC; adaptive mode has 33.08% cumulative return but -41.01% maximum drawdown. Its summary did not save per-stock component scores or validation gates.
hypothesis: Negative overall IC may be localized to the baseline, text coverage, technology subset or mismatch between native 20-bar targets and five-bar evaluation. Diagnose on unchanged scores before considering new alpha.

fixed_design.dates: Exactly the 73 V20r2 common-calendar rebalance dates
fixed_design.aggregation: Pairwise finite, per-date Spearman; report annual and all-period equal-date means and valid counts. Constant or fewer than 3 observations is missing, not zero.
fixed_design.reproduction: Every date: V16-control and adaptive IC5, legacy IC20 and technology IC5 match frozen V20r2 at atol=1e-9, rtol=1e-7; mismatch fails the run.
fixed_design.trace: Per-year exclusive score files, raw probability/magnitude, target maturity dates, event counts and past-only validation gate diagnostics

prohibited: change weights, horizons, thresholds, score signs or fitting parameters
pick winning components as a new production model
reuse lowvol_top20 shadow as candidate evidence
next_decision: Verify reproduction and inspect complete component results. Only then register one evidence-backed new hypothesis; do not automatically search weights or invert negative scores.
performance_status: Parent aggregate results already observed; component traces not yet generated. This is retrospective diagnosis, not a blind test.
